messages:
liam: Heads up — bringing up myriad14b-int4 on the canary fleet and we're seeing intermittent OOMs + aggressive memory fragmentation under small concurrent requests. Started ~10:20 UTC on canary nodes.
anika: Can you paste the logs / command you used to repro? rough numbers help (batch sizes, max_new_tokens)
liam: Repro command: `rb-infer --model myriad14b-int4 --batch-size 8 --max-new-tokens 512 --prefetch true`
Logs show repeated `CUDA OOM` during kv cache allocation, plus lots of tiny free/alloc churn. Heap snapshots attached to the ticket (will link). :frowning:
ravi: Two quick hypotheses: 1) max_new_tokens default too large for our microburst profile (small requests but sometimes 400+ tokens cumulatively), 2) slot allocator fragmentation with prefetched KV slots. Try lowering max_new_tokens and enabling slot compaction.
jen: Agree. On similar models we had wins dropping default max_new_tokens -> 256 and setting `slot_compact=true`. Could we try canary with those flags?
liam: Pushed a canary with: `model-config: { default_max_new_tokens: 256, slot_compact: true, batch_micro_size: 4 }` — canary deployed a minute ago. ops-bot: deploy canary/ami-4812 -> SUCCESS @ 7162712380 :rocket:
anika: After that change, initial runs show fewer OOMs but latency tail increases a bit (more compaction work). Is that acceptable for canary perf SLOs?
ravi: For canary we accept small p99 delta if it stops OOMs. Also try soft-fallback to fp16 variant when memory pressure > 85%: route policy `fallback_on_mem_pressure: true` to avoid service outages.
liam: Ran a quick qa/eval suite — int4 quality delta vs fp16: -0.7% F1 on our abstractive QA eval after these runtime changes. We should track whether compaction or quantization causes it.
jen: That quality hit is within expected quantization noise (we saw similar in earlier int4 experiments). Recommend: 1) run targeted eval with calibration samples (per-channel calibration) 2) re-run small-batch A/B (fp16 vs int4) for 24h.
anika: Also observed a log pattern: `kv_slot_evicted: true` spikes during bursts, followed by `alloc_fail` 10-30s later. Suggest increasing soft-reserve to 20MB per-slot in config as intermediate mitigation.
liam: Will open PR with changes + canary metrics and logs: PR #3245. Also creating issue with heap snapshots + perf traces: ISSUE-1289.
ravi: If canary stabilizes, plan to roll the config to dedicated for 1h soak, then update model defaults. If not, rollback to fp16 canary. Keep me tagged.
jen: One more ask — add a small instrumentation metric: `slot_fragmentation_ratio` and threshold alert >0.65. That would help catch regressions early.
liam: Added instrumentation in PR branch. Monitoring dashboard updated. I'll post follow-up with A/B results tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
